data.long_meaning: The name Maddox is of Old English origin and is derived from the elements mad, meaning 'mighty,' and dox, meaning 'son.' In Welsh mythology, Madoc was a legendary hero who sailed to America before Christopher Columbus. This name was popularized in the Middle Ages and was often given to sons born into noble families. The name Maddox carries the meaning “Son of Madoc” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Maddox usually hope their child will grow to embody son of madoc and live with faith, good character and purpose.
